```python
import pychrono.irrlicht as irr

import pychrono.sensor as sensor
import math
import random

chrono.SetChronoDataPath(chrono.GetChronoDataPath())
veh.SetDataPath(chrono.GetChronoDataPath() + 'vehicle/')

initRot = chrono.ChQuaterniond(1, 0, 0, 0)

terrainWidth = 100.0   # size in Y direction

contact_vis = False

# Simulation step sizes
step_size = 1e-3
tire_step_size = step_size

# Time interval between two render frames
render_step_size = 1.0 / 50  # FPS = 50

vehicle.SetContactMethod(contact_method)
vehicle.SetChassisCollisionType(chassis_collision_type)
vehicle.SetChassisFixed(False)
vehicle.SetInitPosition(chrono.ChCoordsysd(initLoc, initRot))
vehicle.SetTireType(tire_model)
vehicle.SetTireStepSize(tire_step_size)
vehicle.Initialize()

# Set visualization types
vehicle.SetChassisVisualizationType(vis_type)
vehicle.SetSuspensionVisualizationType(vis_type)
vehicle.SetSteeringVisualizationType(vis_type)
vehicle.SetWheelVisualizationType(vis_type)
vehicle.SetTireVisualizationType(vis_type)

# Set collision system type
vehicle.GetSystem().SetCollisionSystemType(chrono.ChCollisionSystem.Type_BULLET)

# Create the SCM deformable terrain patch
terrain = veh.SCMTerrain(vehicle.GetSystem())
terrain.SetSoilParameters(2e6,   # Bekker Kphi
                         0,     # Bekker Kc
                         1.1,   # Bekker n exponent
                         0,     # Mohr cohesive limit (Pa)
                         30,    # Mohr friction limit (degrees)
                         0.01,  # Janosi shear coefficient (m)
                         2e8,   # Elastic stiffness (Pa/m), before plastic yield
                         3e4    # Damping (Pa s/m), proportional to negative vertical speed
)

# Optionally, enable moving patch feature
terrain.AddMovingPatch(vehicle.GetChassisBody(), chrono.ChVector3d(0, 0, 0), chrono.ChVector3d(5, 3, 1))
terrain.SetPlotType(veh.SCMTerrain.PLOT_SINKAGE, 0, 0.1)
terrain.Initialize(20, 20, 0.02)

driver = veh.ChInteractiveDriverIRR(vis)
steering_time = 1.0
throttle_time = 1.0
braking_time = 0.3

driver.SetThrottleDelta(render_step_size / throttle_time)
driver.SetBrakingDelta(render_step_size / braking_time)

def add_random_boxes(system, num_boxes=10, min_size=0.5, max_size=2.0):
    """Add randomly positioned boxes to the simulation"""
    for i in range(num_boxes):
        # Generate random position (avoid vehicle area)
        while True:
            x = random.uniform(-20, 20)
            y = random.uniform(-20, 20)
            z = random.uniform(0.5, 3.0)

            # Check if position is too close to vehicle
            dist_to_vehicle = math.sqrt((x - initLoc.x)**2 + (y - initLoc.y)**2)
            if dist_to_vehicle > 5:  # Minimum distance from vehicle
                break

        # Random size
        size_x = random.uniform(min_size, max_size)
        size_y = random.uniform(min_size, max_size)
        size_z = random.uniform(min_size, max_size)

        # Create box
        box = chrono.ChBodyEasyBox(size_x, size_y, size_z, 1000)  # 1000 kg/m^3 density
        box.SetPos(chrono.ChVector3d(x, y, z))
        box.SetBodyFixed(False)
        box.SetCollide(True)
        box.GetVisualModel().SetColor(chrono.ChColor(random.random(), random.random(), random.random()))

        # Add to system
        system.Add(box)

# Add boxes to the vehicle system
add_random_boxes(vehicle.GetSystem(), num_boxes=15)

# ---------------
# Add Point Lights
# ---------------
def add_point_lights(vis, num_lights=5):
    """Add point lights to the scene"""
    for i in range(num_lights):
        x = random.uniform(-30, 30)
        y = random.uniform(-30, 30)
        z = random.uniform(5, 15)

        # Random color
        r = random.random()
        g = random.random()
        b = random.random()

        vis.AddPointLight(chrono.ChVector3d(x, y, z),
                          chrono.ChColor(r, g, b),
                          20.0)  # radius

# Add lights to the visualization
add_point_lights(vis, num_lights=8)

# ---------------
# Sensor System
# ---------------
# Create sensor manager
sensor_manager = sensor.ChSensorManager(vehicle.GetSystem())

# Camera parameters
camera_res_x = 640
camera_res_y = 480
camera_fov = 60  # degrees

# Create a camera sensor attached to the vehicle chassis
camera = sensor.ChCameraSensor(
    vehicle.GetChassisBody(),          # body camera is attached to
    10,                                # update rate (Hz)
    chrono.ChFrameD(                   # offset pose
        chrono.ChVector3d(0, 0, 1.8),  # position (on top of vehicle)
        chrono.Q_from_AngAxis(chrono.CH_C_PI/2, chrono.ChVector3d(0, 0, 1))  # look forward
    ),
    camera_res_x,                      # width
    camera_res_y,                      # height
    camera_fov * chrono.CH_C_PI / 180  # fov in radians
)

# Configure camera settings
camera.SetName("front_camera")
camera.PushFilter(sensor.ChFilterVisualize(camera_res_x, camera_res_y, "Camera Feed"))
camera.PushFilter(sensor.ChFilterRGBA8ToDepth())
camera.PushFilter(sensor.ChFilterPCfromDepth(0.1, 100))  # near and far clipping planes

# Add camera to sensor manager
sensor_manager.AddSensor(camera)

# Initialize the sensor manager
sensor_manager.SetUpdateMode(sensor.ChSensorManager.UpdateMode::SYNCHRONOUS)
sensor_manager.Initialize()

# ---------------
# Simulation loop
# ---------------
print("VEHICLE MASS: ", vehicle.GetVehicle().GetMass())

# Number of simulation steps between miscellaneous events
render_steps = math.ceil(render_step_size / step_size)

# Initialize simulation frame counter
realtime_timer = chrono.ChRealtimeStepTimer()
step_number = 0
render_frame = 0

# Create a window for the camera feed
camera_window = irr.ChIrrAppInterface(vis.GetDevice(), "Camera Feed", irr.dimension2du(640, 480))
camera_window.AddTypicalLogo()
camera_window.AddTypicalSky()
camera_window.AddTypicalLights()
camera_window.AddCamera(irr.core.vector3df(0, 0, 0), irr.core.vector3df(0, 0, 1))
camera_window.AssetBindAll()
camera_window.AssetUpdateAll()

while vis.Run():
    time = vehicle.GetSystem().GetChTime()

    # Render scene and output POV-Ray data
    if (step_number % render_steps == 0):
        vis.BeginScene()
        vis.Render()

        # Update and render camera feed
        sensor_manager.Update()
        camera_window.BeginScene()
        camera_window.DrawAll()
        camera_window.EndScene()

        vis.EndScene()
        render_frame += 1

    # Get driver inputs
    driver_inputs = driver.GetInputs()

    # Update modules
    driver.Synchronize(time)
    terrain.Synchronize(time)
    vehicle.Synchronize(time, driver_inputs, terrain)
    vis.Synchronize(time, driver_inputs)

    # Advance simulation
    driver.Advance(step_size)
    terrain.Advance(step_size)
    vehicle.Advance(step_size)
    vis.Advance(step_size)

    # Increment frame number
    step_number += 1

    # Spin for real time
    realtime_timer.Spin(step_size)
```

```python
import pychrono as chrono
import pychrono.irrlicht as chronoirr
import pychrono.vehicle as veh
import pychrono.vehicle.wheeled_vehicle as wheeled_vehicle
import pychrono.fea as fea
import numpy as np
import math

# =============================================================================
# Simulation parameters
# =============================================================================

# Simulation step size
step_size = 0.02  # 50 FPS

# Simulation end time
tend = 100

# Time response output
output_step = 0.02

# Point on chassis tracked by the camera
trackPoint = chrono.ChVectorD(0.0, 0.0, 0.0)

# =============================================================================
# Create the systems and set solver parameters
# =============================================================================

# Create the vehicle system
vehicle = wheeled_vehicle.ChWheeledVehicle(chrono.GetChronoDataFile('vehicle/hmmwv/vehicle/HMMWV_Vehicle.json'),
                                          chrono.GetChronoDataFile('vehicle/hmmwv/powertrain/HMMWV_PowertrainSimpleMap.json'),
                                          chrono.GetChronoDataFile('vehicle/hmmwv/tire/HMMWV_TMeasyTire.json'),
                                          wheeled_vehicle.ChVehicleModelData::Type::RIGID,
                                          wheeled_vehicle.ChCollisionSystem::Type::PRIMITIVES)

vehicle.SetChassisFixed(False)
vehicle.SetInitPosition(chrono.ChCoorD<>(chrono.ChVectorD<>(0, 0, 0.5), chrono.Q_from_AngAxis(-math.pi/2, chrono.VECT_Y)))
vehicle.SetInitFwdVel(5)

vehicle.Initialize()

vehicle.SetChassisVisualizationType(veh.ChVisualization::Type::MESH)
vehicle.SetSuspensionVisualizationType(veh.ChVisualization::Type::PRIMITIVES)
vehicle.SetSteeringVisualizationType(veh.ChVisualization::Type::PRIMITIVES)
vehicle.SetWheelVisualizationType(veh.ChVisualization::Type::MESH)

vehicle.SetChassisCollisionType(veh.ChCollision::Type::PRIMITIVES)
vehicle.SetSuspensionCollisionType(veh.ChCollision::Type::PRIMITIVES)
vehicle.SetSteeringCollisionType(veh.ChCollision::Type::PRIMITIVES)
vehicle.SetWheelCollisionType(veh.ChCollision::Type::PRIMITIVES)

vehicle.GetSystem().Set_G_acc(chrono.ChVectorD(0, 0, -9.81))

# =============================================================================
# Create the terrain
# =============================================================================

# Terrain dimensions
terrainLength = 100.0  # size in X direction
terrainWidth = 100.0   # size in Y direction

# Create the SCM terrain
scm_terrain = veh.ChTerrainSCM(vehicle.GetSystem())

# Set soil parameters
scm_terrain.SetSoilParameters(1e6,      # Bekker Kphi
                               0,        # Bekker Kc
                               1.1,      # Bekker n exponent
                               0.0,      # Mohr cohesive limit (Pa)
                               30,       # Mohr friction limit (degrees)
                               0.01,     # Friction coefficient
                               1500,     # Soil density (kg/m^3)
                               0.3,      # Soil Poisson ratio
                               0.1,      # Plastic yield displacement
                               0.01,     # Damping coefficient
                               0.0)      # Adhesion coefficient

# Set moving patch parameters
scm_terrain.SetMovingPatchSize(10.0, 10.0)  # patch dimensions
scm_terrain.SetMovingPatchCenter(chrono.ChVectorD(0, 0, 0))  # initial position
scm_terrain.SetMovingPatchActive(True)  # enable moving patch

# Initialize the terrain at the specified height
scm_terrain.Initialize(0,  # height
                       0.02)  # mesh resolution

# =============================================================================
# Visualization
# =============================================================================

# Create the vehicle Irrlicht interface
vis = chronoirr.ChVehicleVisualSystemIrrlicht()
vis.SetWindowSize(1280, 720)
vis.SetWindowTitle('HMMWV on SCM Terrain')
vis.Initialize()
vis.AddLogo()
vis.AddSkyBox()
vis.AddTypicalLights()
vis.AddCamera(chrono.ChVectorD(0.0, 0.0, 1.75),  # camera location
              chrono.ChVectorD(6.0, 0.0, 0.0))  # "look at" location
vis.AttachVehicle(vehicle.GetVehicle())

# Enable sinkage visualization with false color plotting
scm_terrain.SetPlotSinkage(True)
scm_terrain.SetPlotType(veh.ChTerrain::PlotType::COLOR)
scm_terrain.SetColorRange(0.0, 0.2)  # sinkage range for color mapping

# =============================================================================
# Create the driver system
# =============================================================================

driver = veh.ChDriver(vehicle)
driver.SetSteeringDelta(0.02)
driver.SetThrottleDelta(0.02)
driver.SetBrakingDelta(0.02)

# Set up interactive driver
driver.SetDriverModel(veh.ChDriver::DriverModelType::INTERACTIVE_DRIVER)
driver.Initialize()

# =============================================================================
# Simulation loop
# =============================================================================

# Number of simulation steps between two 3D view render frames
vis_steps = int(math.ceil(output_step / step_size))

# Initialize simulation frame counter
step_number = 0

# Simulation loop
while vis.Run():
    time = vehicle.GetSystem().GetChTime()

    # End simulation
    if time >= tend:
        break

    # Update moving patch to follow vehicle
    chassis_pos = vehicle.GetChassis().GetPos()
    scm_terrain.SetMovingPatchCenter(chrono.ChVectorD(chassis_pos.x, chassis_pos.y, 0))

    # Driver inputs
    driver.Synchronize(time)
    vehicle.Synchronize(time, driver.GetSteering(), driver.GetThrottle(), driver.GetBraking())

    # Advance simulation for one timestep for all modules
    driver.Advance(step_size)
    vehicle.Advance(step_size)
    scm_terrain.Advance(step_size)

    # Update visualization
    if (step_number % vis_steps == 0):
        vis.BeginScene()
        vis.Render()
        vis.EndScene()

    step_number += 1

# =============================================================================
# Clean up
# =============================================================================

# Remove visualization assets
vis.RemoveAllPointLights()
vis.Delete()
```
